name: Together AI
label: Together AI
description: Official Together Inference API (chat, completions, embeddings, image_gen, list models) on the v2 agent model contract (INPUT llm_input → OUTPUT llm_output). Auth is StudioQuack secret api_key sent as Authorization Bearer. Vision/image inputs use type file (platform ref-id). Docs: https://docs.together.ai/docs/inference/openai-compatibility. Terms: https://www.together.ai/terms-of-service. Never log api_key.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: llm_input
ports.description: v2 LLM request so this node can sit on the AI Agent model FUNCTION port. Shape: {messages, tools?, prompt?, input?, file?}. Vision/image use type file (platform ref-id). Do not put api_key here.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which Together call to run. EXACT: chat | completions | embeddings | image_gen | list_models. Overrides config operation. Example: chat. https://docs.together.ai/reference/chat-completions

schema.label: messages
schema.description: Chat Completions messages. Vision: image_url HTTPS or data URI from type file. Example: [{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}]. Together ids are namespaced (org/name).

schema.label: tools
schema.description: Optional chat tools. Omit or [] sends no tools.

schema.label: prompt
schema.description: completions prompt or image_gen prompt when messages is omitted.

schema.label: input
schema.description: embeddings input (string or string[]).

schema.label: file
schema.description: Platform file ref-id for vision chat or image_gen reference. Never inline bytes in graph JSON.

schema.label: inputFiles
schema.description: user-uploaded files and voice clips for the model

children.label: kind
children.description: File kind: image, document, audio, or video.

children.label: mime_type
children.description: RFC 1521 media type, e.g. application/pdf, image/png

children.label: source
children.description: How the payload is carried: base64 or url.

children.label: data
children.description: base64-encoded payload (when source=base64) or absolute URL (when source=url)

children.label: name
children.description: Original filename, surfaced as the upload name

schema.label: max_tokens

ports.name: llm_output
ports.description: v2 LLM response envelope. Success includes status/data from OfficialApiNode. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed Together JSON (chat, completions, embeddings, images, or models list).

schema.label: result
schema.description: canonical assistant payload {role,content,tool_calls?,output_files?,…}

schema.label: outputFiles
schema.description: files produced by the model, e.g. generated images/audio

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official Together verb. EXACT values: chat | completions | embeddings | image_gen | list_models. Default chat = POST /v1/chat/completions.

configurationParameters.label: API Key
configurationParameters.description: Together project API key. Sent as Authorization Bearer. StudioQuack secret binding only. Never logged. Empty → error 'api_key is required'.

configurationParameters.label: Model
configurationParameters.description: Together namespaced model id (org/name). Default meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Turbo (still in the serverless catalog). Current also: Qwen/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B, Qwen/Qwen3.7-Max, Qwen/Qwen3.6-Plus, MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3, moonshotai/Kimi-K3. Flat OpenAI ids 404. Verify via list_models. Docs: https://docs.together.ai/docs/serverless/models .

configurationParameters.label: Temperature
configurationParameters.description: Chat/completions temperature when present on INPUT. Empty → omitted.

configurationParameters.label: Stream
configurationParameters.description: Purpose: controls whether Together AI requests a streamed completion and fans live deltas through helper emitPartial. Canonical flag. When true the node POSTs stream:true, parses SSE data: lines, emitPartial("thinking", delta) for reasoning/thinking and emitPartial("answer", delta) for content; thoughts also appear on llm_output.result.thoughts / thinking; finish_reason, usage and tool_calls are assembled at the end. Accepted: select true | false. Default: true. Invalid/blank → true. Example: true.
